findings.message: 1 line in "Overdose? Check, then call 111" has no quote from the guideline ("It may be an opioid overdose if they:"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Get the naloxone ready" has no quote from the guideline ("Snap the top off. Which way the dot faces differs:"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
2 lines in "Breathing well, or waking?" have no quote from the guideline ("No response? The sources say give another dose with a new…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
2 lines in "They woke up: stay with them" have no quote from the guideline ("How long naloxone lasts differs:"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Tell the paramedics" has no quote from the guideline ("The Log also has when 111 was called, the recovery positi…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
The guideline mentions 5 amounts the template never uses: 23 g, 25 g, 25 °c, 1.8 mg, 0.4 ml. Some may be background; check none were left out.
Nobody is named under "Reviewed by:", so the app shows "Not reviewed".
The saved guideline text is a web copy made by a fetch tool and may not be word-perfect, so a "quote not found" may be the copy's fault. Add the PDF to sources/ for exact checking.
